rows.quote: Protein data were sourced from two large cohorts: UKB-PPP, where proteins were measured using the Olink platform in 54,219 individuals, and deCODE, where proteins were measured using the SomaScan platform in 35,559 individuals.
rows.coder_note: deCODE with the SomaScan platform in exactly 35,559 individuals matches only the Ferkingstad 2021 row (the Eldjarn 2023 row has 35,892); nothing conflicts.
